title: Grateful Dead Live at Crystal Ballroom on 1968-02-03

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a stellar February‑1968 Anthem‑era set with standout China Cat, The Eleven, Cryptical > Other One and New Potato, presented with clear audio.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its tight, psychedelic performances during the intense Anthem‑of‑the‑Sun sessions – highlights include a sparkling China Cat Sunflower, an energetic The Eleven, a seamless Cryptical > That’s It For The Other One, and a vibrant New Potato that flows into a rare Born‑Crossed.  The soundboard source is generally clean and well‑balanced, with no major audio complaints, though some listeners wish the track splitting preserved the continuity of the TOO suite.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews average 4 ★, with strong musical praise and no serious recording flaws; weighting favors the high‑quality performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No notable sound issues reported; reviewers focus on musical content rather than audio problems, indicating a clear and balanced capture.

standout_songs: Cryptical > That's It For The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight sequencing with New Potato leading into a rare Born‑Crossed; the set reflects the focused, proto‑prog experimentation of the Anthem era.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s vocals are highlighted as strong and engaging.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ adds vivid color and intensity throughout the jams.
